_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the infra-image acceptance ledger. The live ledger is a private record at monitor/private/image-acceptance.json (CW_IMAGE_ACCEPTANCE overrides; absent means monitor/image-acceptance.mjs states that it did not run). For every residual CRIT/HIGH in a deployed infra image with no available fix, it records the digest pin, why it cannot be fixed, the reachability verdict, the containment controls and a re-check trigger. Anything not fixed-by-a-track and not accepted-with-containment here is a FAIL.

controls.C1: no-new-privileges:true — blocks setuid privilege escalation inside the container
controls.C2: cap_drop:[ALL] — removes the capabilities an OS-level CVE would need

accepted.reachability: unreachable-in-role: the database server never invokes this base-image tool
accepted.recheckTrigger: a base-image security update for example-base-tool

fixableViaRebuild.fix: fixed upstream; needs an image rebuild

fixed.fix: rebuilt on the patched base image
